page_title: BRE 3-2 LEN | Brest v Lens 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Jeremie Pignard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Deiver Machado (Lens) steps up to take the free kick, but his crossfield pass fails to reach any of his teammates.
90+6' Massadio Haidara (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Bizot comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' Axel Camblan (Brest) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Romain Del Castillo.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Kenny Lala (Brest) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
87' 3 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Romain Del Castillo (Brest) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Brice Samba no chance!
87' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is going to take the penalty!
86' The main referee, Jeremie Pignard, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Brice Samba (Lens) is given a yellow card for dissent.

86' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brest are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stijn Spierings (Lens) comes onto the pitch for Andy Diouf.

82' It's a foul from Adrien Thomasson (Lens). Surprisingly, the referee comes and pulls out a red card. It was a very harsh one and Adrien Thomasson (Lens) complains, but it's no use of course. The decision has been made.
82' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Brice Samba to make a comfortable save.
78' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Przemyslaw Frankowski and he is replaced by Julien Le Cardinal (Lens).
78' The ball falls kindly for Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar.
77' PENALTY APPEAL by Lens, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
76' That will be all from Martin Satriano who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Steve Mounie (Brest).
75' Andy Diouf (Lens) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
74' Lens take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' Florian Sotoca (Lens) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
70' Deiver Machado (Lens) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.
68' It's time for a substitution. Adrien Thomasson (Lens) comes on in place of Morgan Guilavogui.
68' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. David Costa (Lens) replaces Angelo Fulgini.
67' Here is a change. Mathias Pereira Lage is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Mahdi Camara (Brest).
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jonas Martin (Brest) for Hugo Magnetti.
66' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
65' Brest can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brest.

65' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brest will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' A pass by Deiver Machado (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

56' 2 - 2 Goal! Kenny Lala (Brest) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Brice Samba is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:2.
56' The corner is swung in but Brest can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brest.
54' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
54' Now Brest have a corner.

53' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Brice Samba! The ball goes out of play and Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
52' A yellow card for a tackle by Facundo Medina (Lens). Jeremie Pignard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
51' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.

50' The game is interrupted. Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Brest are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
48' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremie Pignard ignores the protests.
48' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Substitution. Massadio Haidara (Lens) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jonathan Gradit walks off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A cross from a corner kick by Lens is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
45+3' The foul by Lilian Brassier (Brest) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jeremie Pignard.
45+2' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Brice Samba into the bottom right corner.
45+1' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty kick to Brest!!
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Romain Del Castillo (Brest) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Brice Samba easily catches the ball.
43' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) whips in a cross from the corner, but Marco Bizot is well positioned and punches the ball away.

42' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.

40' Martin Satriano (Brest) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
40' Brest are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
37' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
37' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Brest earn a corner.
35' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) for a tough tackle.
34' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

28' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lens are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
22' 0 - 2 Deiver Machado (Lens) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marco Bizot with a strike into the left side of the goal. He makes it 0:2.
20' Dangerous play by Salis Abdul Samed (Lens). Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul. Brest have a free kick.
17' Martin Satriano (Brest) misses a big chance as his shot goes wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
13' A corner kick by Lens is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Bizot (Brest).

11' 0 - 1 Florian Sotoca (Lens) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Angelo Fulgini. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the left post behind the goalkeeper. It's 0:1.
10' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) steps up to send the ball in.

10' Deiver Machado (Lens) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
8' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Brice Samba intercepts the ball.
5' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
3' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
1' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marco Bizot comes off the line to clear the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Lens will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Jeremie Pignard.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
